title: Typing a term shows grouped results with counts and highlighting
permissions_required: Any signed-in user of the ShopView App. Whether search results are scoped by role is to confirm — pending Branko's PRD.
preconditions: 1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. Some sample work orders, customers, assets, parts and vendors exist.
steps: 2. Type a few letters (for example 'Fib') into the search box.
expected: 1. Results are grouped by type with a count next to each group heading, for example 'Work orders (2)', 'Customers (2)', 'Vendors (1)', 'Assets (2)', 'Parts (1)'.
2. The matching part of each result is highlighted in yellow.
3. Each work order row shows its number, name, a status pill (for example Approved or Estimate), the person and a date.
4. Behaviour to confirm — pending Branko's product write-up; to be checked live once the feature is available. (how matching works — exact vs fuzzy — and the ranking order).
notes: Design-only (grouped results + highlighting). Matching/ranking behaviour pending confirmation.
